based_on: OSRS item design lexicon, 938-item analytical sample, ~80K words of analysis
purpose: Queryable rules database the Scape art generator consumes. Given (category, tier, material, origin, region, iconic_break_axis, sub_aesthetic, state_register), compose() returns a complete prompt-ready spec.

universal.spec: 1-2px topologically-complete dark outline at #000000 (pure black). No gaps, no soft edges, no anti-aliasing. Binary alpha only.
universal.evidence_count: 11899/11899 icons (99.96% strict compliance; 0.04% are pastry/crest/fin design choices that brush perimeter)
universal.exceptions: Cosmetic exo-items (Scape's equivalent of partyhats) MAY shift outline color — but only because they're designed to read as out-of-world
universal.scape_application: Every Scape inventory icon outlines at #000000, 1-2px, complete enclosure, binary alpha. Apply via post-process: trace silhouette, paint perimeter at #000000, enforce binary alpha.

universal.spec: Secondary dark lines that subdivide the silhouette use the same #000000 as the rim, never a lighter gray.
universal.evidence_count: Dragon-claws 100 interior dark pixels, Torva platebody 259, all at #000000
universal.scape_application: Interior subdivisions (blade-from-guard, plate-seam) use perimeter color exactly.

universal.spec: Default 1px baseline. 55-80% of perimeter samples at exactly 1px. 2px permitted only on apex curves and silhouette-signature features. 3+px does not occur as a design choice.
universal.scape_application: Generator targets 1px outline by default; permits 2px on auto-detected curve apexes.

universal.spec: Zero animation in inventory icon. No pulse, no particle, no rotation, no shimmer, no glow aura, no shader effect. Specular is fixed-pixel composition, not animated.
universal.scape_application: Inventory render layer uses no animation. Animation lives in world entities (sword swings, spell casts, pet idle), never in inventory.

universal.spec: Reversible mechanical states (imbued/base, poisoned/un-poisoned, charged/un-charged) are pixel-identical icons. Specular changes only on permanent art transitions (ornament kits, re-skins, blessed conversions).
universal.scape_application: Imbued/charged variants share base sprite. Only ornament-kit upgrades produce new sprites.

universal.spec: Canvas is silhouette's shrink-wrap plus 1-2px outline padding. Not a fixed grid. Canvas dimensions are themselves a category signal.
universal.scape_application: Canvas falls out of bbox computation. Per-category canvas-size table (see categories.* fields). New categories pick a canvas and stick to it.

universal.spec: Icons authored at native ~30px and scaled at runtime with nearest-neighbor only. No bilinear, no smoothing.
universal.scape_application: CSS image-rendering: pixelated; canvas imageSmoothingEnabled = false. Author at native canvas, never produce 256px master and downscale.

universal.spec: At 30px no atmospheric noise. Every pixel conveys silhouette, material, detail, specular, or — at ultra tier — deliberate negative space.
universal.scape_application: Generator critique step: reject outputs with 'noise' or 'background atmosphere'. Re-prompt with 'every pixel has intent' constraint.

universal.spec: Ultra tier permits MORE negative space than mid-tier as prestige rhetoric. Common-tier weapons fill 0.40-0.55; ultra-tier signature weapons fill 0.20-0.30.
universal.evidence_count: Scythe 0.201, Crystal Halberd 0.15, Zamorakian Spear 0.11, Shadow 0.20
universal.scape_application: Per-tier fill_ratio_range; lower tiers fill more, ultra tiers fill less.

universal.spec: Low-tier items are literal renderings. High-tier items are stylized symbols of themselves. Progression: functional → idealized → iconic → mythic. Form serves recognition over realism the higher you go.
universal.scape_application: Per-category abstraction-curve in tiers.* range. Mid-tier flat plateau is intentional — don't ornament mid-tier to make it feel valuable.

universal.spec: At ultra tier, items break exactly ONE design dimension (silhouette OR palette OR material-treatment) and stay disciplined on the others. Multi-axis maximalism hurts legibility.
universal.evidence_count: Twisted Bow (silhouette), Shadow (palette), 3rd Age (material), Torva (silhouette), Bandos chestplate (silhouette), Phat (extreme-restraint)
universal.scape_application: Every ultra-tier item tagged with break_axis: 'silhouette' | 'palette' | 'material' | 'restraint'. Generator picks exactly one.

universal.spec: One master palette (~48 colors). All items draw from master or named sub-palettes (per-faction, per-region, per-material). No item introduces colors not in the master.
universal.scape_application: data/sprite-palettes.json defines scape.master + scape.regions.* + scape.factions.* + scape.materials.*. Generator validates all output colors against master.

universal.spec: Each faction has a 3-hex triplet (primary + secondary + accent + black). Faction items pull only from triplet + master.
universal.scape_application: Per-faction triplet stored in factions.*. Faction-branded items inherit triplet as primary palette.

universal.spec: Each tier has a signature hex (±8 per-channel tolerance). Mithril is INDIGO not blue-green.
2-3 banded shading layers per surface. Not gradient. Not dithered fade. Light source upper-left across entire library.
universal.evidence_count: 109/109 sampled iconic items use 2-3 discrete bands
universal.scape_application: Shading computed: material → tier-palette → derive 2-3 luminance bands → pick shadow from named token matching dominant hue family.

universal.spec: Items communicate, not illustrate. Visual rhetoric matches mechanic. Weird-scaling items look weird; holy items look holy; cursed items look wrong.
universal.scape_application: Iconic items get hand-prompted with explicit mechanic-to-visual mapping.

low.notes: Functional renderings. Reads as commodity / starter / found.

mid.notes: Cleaner palette, faint specular, slight ornament. Plateau intentional — don't ornament here to make it feel valuable.

high.notes: Palette-break rung. First palette no real metal could be (cyan). Saturated signature, clear specular ping. Reads as 'prestige material'.

mega.notes: Dragon-rung double-break. Color AND ornament escalate together. Silhouette softly deviates (sharper curve, wider proportions). Largest single jump in abstraction curve.

ultra.specular_count_paradox: May be ZERO for matte ultras (Shadow, Torva) — restraint-as-prestige
ultra.notes: Single-axis discipline. Break exactly one of silhouette / palette / material. Multi-axis breaks look like fan-art.

black.notes: Composite items invert luminance (metal darker than leather). Restraint as tier signal.

mithril.palette_correction: INDIGO not blue-green per Wave A3 finding across 8 mithril slots

barrows_tarnished.notes: Each Barrows-equivalent set has unique silhouette family + 1-2 unique colors atop tarnished base.

third_age.notes: Restrained gold visibility at 30px — gold-trim fans associate with 3rd Age lives in 3D model not inventory icon.

crystal.notes: Lower fill — 'light passing through.' Faceted texture.

void_shadow.notes: Absorbs light. Specular reserved for one signature point (orb, eye).

wood_low.notes: Universal weapon-handle/haft material across all metal-tier weapons.

leather.notes: Universal composite-armor material. Boot shaft, kiteshield rim. Byte-identical across bronze through rune.

weapon.scimitar.mega_deviation: sharper curve, slimmer silhouette (210 opaque vs standard 258)

weapon.dagger.mega_deviation: DRAMATICALLY smaller (14×26) — only dagger that reads as 'blade not sword'

weapon.staff.ultra_example: Tumeken's Shadow stays inside template (30×28) — apex-ness in palette only

armor.full_helm.mega_deviation: Dragon flips to 30×26 wider-than-tall (1.154 aspect), horns replace plume

armor.platebody.ultra_example: 3rd Age stays at 30×23 — keeps silhouette, breaks via palette

armor.kiteshield.mega_deviation: Dragon breaks cross-rib with asymmetric upper-right gray insert
armor.kiteshield.ultra_deviation: 3rd Age uses solid silver face with central darker umbo — no cross-rib, no leather rim

magic.rune.combination_runes: 92-112 color palettes due to blended-hue intermediates

craft.spec: Inherits category template + tier palette + tier-appropriate ornament. The default.

quest_gate.spec: ~10% of quest items. Existing tier items the quest happens to gate. Use standard tier-material pipeline.

quest_artefact.spec: ~90% of quest items. Bespoke art with quest-resistance rules.
rules: Palette-resistance: NO tier-metal palettes. Pick from lore/faction/regional/property palette.
Anatomical plausibility: silhouette stays inside realistic proportions. silhouette_uniqueness 6-8 normal; 9-10 only with narrative singularity.
Narrative-readability mandate: one diegetic cue (silhouette, hue, glyph) teaches function at thumbnail size.

state_registers.used: slight desaturation + 1 outline notch + specular intact
state_registers.weathered: heavier desaturation + rough silhouette edge + specular reduced
state_registers.blessed: silver-shift palette + holy-tinted specular + optional 1px halo accent

channels: silhouette_violation (RESERVED for the apex ultra-tier drop only)
boss_drop.rule: Lesser drops share palette+motif; apex drop additionally breaks silhouette.

monster_drop.spec: Items dropped by monsters incorporate the monster's body parts visibly (bone dagger has bone shape, dragon claws use red+bone palette and curve-talon silhouette).

random_event.spec: Curio aesthetic. Off-master palette signals found-object status. Often slightly off-kilter.

modes.spec: Iconic because visual is unique and distinctive at thumbnail size.
Iconic because rare, despite simple design. Don't add complexity to scarcity-iconic items.
Iconic because of position in a recognized chain.

five_visual_properties: One signature visual element no other item has
Color that's almost its own material (rune-cyan, dragon-red, void-black are identifiers not colors)
iconic_grammar.scape_iconic_audit_target: 80-120 hand-curated items out of ~500 total. These get hand-prompted + pixel-editor cleanup. Other ~400 follow algorithmic rules.
iconic_grammar.spend_silhouette_budget_on_apex_only: One apex per boss / category / faction. Lesser items inherit category template.

junk_grammar.specular_rule: ZERO specular pings. If brightness needed for readability, distribute across interior pixels.
junk_grammar.broken_silhouettes: Depict specific failure mode (axes break at haft, shields at boss, scrolls at corner). Generic cracks look like incomplete art.
junk_grammar.burnt_palette_operator: collapse to charcoal with warm under-hint. 1-3 shading bands. Rebuild whole palette at low luminance — don't add black soot pixels on top.
junk_grammar.joke_junk_rule: Cabbage-shield rule: silhouette-correct for category (valid shield outline, correct proportions, specular where category specular would go — absent in junk case) while substituting joke palette.

output.silhouette_modifier: from tier (mega softens, ultra breaks if break_axis=silhouette)
output.palette: from material + region weighting + faction triplet (if origin=faction)
output.process_state_ops: applied if item is in a chain

exo_palette_cosmetics.spec: Out-of-world cosmetics (Scape's equivalent of partyhats, holiday items, joke items) MAY use forbidden colors and may shift outline color. They are deliberately NOT in the master palette to signal exo-status.
